note: DATA, NOT CODE. This file is the LAYOUT half of the link/layout split (R16 §4, in-toto): a projection's own
adapter_run records say WHAT RAN; this file says what that IMPLIES about required schemas. The artifact selects a
point in this space and can never supply or widen the space itself (D-068 law 8).
Every list below is MEASURED, not asserted. `record_kinds` is lib/certificate.mjs RECORD_KINDS and the per_kind
lists in every shipped manifest. `structural` and `ruleset` are the schemas lib/project.mjs and lib/rules.mjs
actually compile on the projection path. The three `emits` lists were measured by running each adapter ALONE over
the multi-v1 source set — handoff/research/probes/c1/probe_adapter_emits.out — and all three currently emit all six
kinds, so the per-adapter closure does not discriminate TODAY. It is stated per adapter anyway, because the moment
an adapter emits a kind the others do not (a G1 consistency-finding record is the next candidate) the closure must
already be the thing that moves.
THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO `active` FLAG. Activeness is not a property of this tree — it is the selector the
projection supplies through its own adapter_run records. That is what makes D-068 law 4 hold without a flag anyone
